title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;
  • É responsável pela preparação dos materiais que a Companhia divulga para o Mercado Financeiro e pela conferência das informações que são divulgadas para a imprensa;
  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;
  • Preparação e envio de informações para advogados, bancos e órgãos regulamentadores em caso de ofertas públicas de ações ou dívida e controle e monitoramento da base acionária da Companhia;
  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;
  • Preparação dos documentos que precisam ser enviados aos bancos, advogados e órgãos regulamentadores;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho, a evolução e a implementação de arquiteturas de nuvem complexas, resilientes e escaláveis , com foco em OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) e GCP (Google Cloud Platform) .
  • Conduzir a estratégia de sustentação, operação e gestão de ambientes em nuvem para clientes em modelo MSP .
  • Definir, disseminar e implementar a cultura e as práticas de SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) , garantindo confiabilidade, escalabilidade, disponibilidade e alta performance dos sistemas.
  • Orientar a equipe na adoção de boas práticas de DevOps , automação, Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) e segurança em nuvem .
  • Atuar como referência técnica , apoiando a equipe na resolução de incidentes e desafios técnicos de alta complexidade.
  • Implementar, acompanhar e otimizar estratégias de FinOps , promovendo eficiência de custos e uso inteligente dos recursos em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e garantir a aplicação de políticas de Cloud Security , governança e conformidade.
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar ambientes Kubernetes de missão crítica , com profunda expertise em GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) e OKE (Oracle Kubernetes Engine) .
  • Definir e evoluir estratégias de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade , assegurando estabilidade, performance e rápida resposta a incidentes.
  • Mentorar profissionais juniores e plenos , contribuindo para o desenvolvimento técnico e a maturidade do time.


☁️ Requisitos Técnicos

  • Desejável experiência como DevOps
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com OCI e GCP .
  • Experiência com Kubernetes , especialmente GKE e OKE .
  • Expertise em Terraform e Ansible para gerenciamento de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) .
  • Conhecimento comprovada com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade .
  • Vivência em SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) .
  • Experiência em sustentação e operação de ambientes críticos , preferencialmente em modelo MSP .
  • Conhecimentos em Cloud Security e FinOps .


Home office de Segunda a Sexta das 22h às 07h (turno noturno)

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  • Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark "Toxic" in the "Is toxic" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark "Normal"
  • For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the "Note" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  • List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)


Requirements

  • Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  • Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  • Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  • Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  • Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus


Training & Payment

  • Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  • Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  • Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.


Additional Notes

  • The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  • Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Sobre a Umobit

A Umobit é uma agência digital especializada em soluções de crescimento online, além de design e desenvolvimento digital para empresas. Trabalhamos em parceria com marcas para construir bases digitais sólidas e estratégias de performance escaláveis, gerando resultados mensuráveis.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Paid Search Manager para liderar e otimizar campanhas de mídia paga em mecanismos de busca em diferentes plataformas. Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar, implementar e gerenciar campanhas de paid search no Google Ads, Microsoft Ads e outras plataformas relevantes

  • Gerenciar e distribuir orçamentos de forma eficiente para maximizar o ROI
  • Realizar testes A/B em anúncios, palavras-chave e landing pages
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho com insights e recomendações estratégicas
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de design, SEO e desenvolvimento
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências, atualizações das plataformas e boas práticas do mercado

Requisitos

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência prática em gestão de campanhas de paid search
  • Forte conhecimento em Google Ads; experiência com Microsoft Ads é um diferencial
  • Boa compreensão de tracking, analytics e modelos de atribuição
  • Experiência na gestão de orçamentos médios a altos
  • Perfil analítico, orientado(a) a dados e resolução de problemas
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e gerenciar múltiplos projetos
  • Boa comunicação em inglês

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em agência digital

O que oferecemos

  • Modelo de trabalho flexível (remoto ou híbrido)
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos variados e internacionais
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em crescimento

title: Engenheiro de DevSecOps
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão. Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps com foco em segurança e automação.
  • Arquitetar e operar serviços Azure, incluindo AKS e soluções cloud nativas usando IaC.
  • Garantir confiabilidade, monitoramento, observabilidade e segurança das aplicações.
  • Atuar como referência em automação e DevOps, apoiando times ágeis e melhorias contínuas.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência em projetar, implementar e dar suporte a práticas e ferramentas DevSecOps.
  • Experiência com AKS
  • Experiência com Azure
  • Experiência com CI/CD


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;
  • É responsável pela preparação dos materiais que a Companhia divulga para o Mercado Financeiro e pela conferência das informações que são divulgadas para a imprensa;
  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;
  • Preparação e envio de informações para advogados, bancos e órgãos regulamentadores em caso de ofertas públicas de ações ou dívida e controle e monitoramento da base acionária da Companhia;
  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;
  • Preparação dos documentos que precisam ser enviados aos bancos, advogados e órgãos regulamentadores;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

title: Full-Stack Developer / UI Designer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a hybrid Developer/Designer who can build modern, scalable web

experiences using TypeScript, Next.js, Node and related technologies, while also producing

polished, on-brand UI/UX in Figma. This role blends engineering, design, and AI-assised

development. The ideal candidate moves quickly, takes initiative, and delivers exceptional

quality with minimal oversight.


Responsibilities

Full-Stack Web Development

● Build and maintain headless websites and applications using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and TypeScript.

● Implement responsive, performant, and accessible front-end interfaces aligned with design specs.

● Develop backend functionality, APIs, serverless functions, and integrations.

● Ensure high standards for code quality, testing, maintainability, and documentation.

● Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot) to accelerate coding workflows and improve output quality.

● Identify architectural improvements, technical optimizations, and opportunities for automation.

● Collaborate with marketing, engineering, and product teams on cross-functional initiatives.


Web Design / UI & UX

● Create polished, intuitive, on-brand designs and prototypes in Figma.

● Maintain and evolve design systems, component libraries, and visual standards.

● Translate brand guidelines into consistent layouts, UI patterns, and interactions.

● Conduct UX improvements across flows, navigation, content structure, and responsiveness.

● Deliver clear handoff files, annotations, and design documentation to ensure smooth implementation.

● Contribute to concept development, ideation, and early-stage visual direction.


Required qualifications

● 4+ years of experience building headless websites or modern web apps, preferably with Next.js.

● Hands-on experience with headless CMSs (Contentful, Prismic, Sanity, etc.)

● Strong proficiency with React, Tailwind, Node.js, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.

● Demonstrated UI/UX ability with a portfolio of Figma designs.

● Experience creating or managing reusable design systems.

● Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex/Copilot).

● Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects with minimal supervision.

● Strong understanding of accessibility, responsive design, and performance optimization.

● Excellent communication skills and comfort with asynchronous collaboration.

● Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with Pacific Time (8 AM–12 PM PT).


Preferred qualifications

● Experience with Webflow.

● Experience with Prismic CMS.

● Experience with cloud platforms (Vercel, AWS, GCP).

● Experience with CI/CD tools

● Experience with the HubSpot API.

● Experience maintaining design systems in Figma.

● Experience building API integrations.

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  • Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark "Toxic" in the "Is toxic" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark "Normal"
  • For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the "Note" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  • List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)


Requirements

  • Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  • Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  • Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  • Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  • Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus


Training & Payment

  • Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  • Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  • Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.


Additional Notes

  • The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  • Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

title: Product Manager / PO (Foco em APIs & Financial Products) | Remoto
description:
A Oportunidade


A CambioReal é uma empresa consolidada há 21 anos e em crescimento(crescemos 79% em receita em 2025). Nosso objetivo para 2026 é ambicioso: evoluir de um Checkout e Plataforma de pagamento internacional de sucesso para uma Infratech de Câmbio Global (Enterprise).


Para isso, buscamos um Technical Product Manager que atue como a ponte entre a Visão de Negócio e o Time de Desenvolvimento.


⚠️ Se você precisa de microgerenciamento para priorizar um backlog, esta vaga não é para você.


Seus Desafios:


Tradução Técnica: Receber as demandas estratégicas (Ex: "Expandir Payouts para Europa" ou "Integração com Plataforma X") e transformar em especificações técnicas detalhadas, User Stories e tarefas claras para os desenvolvedores.


Gestão do Backlog & Sprint: Gerenciar o dia a dia dos nossos Devs, garantindo que a esteira de desenvolvimento nunca pare e que os prazos sejam cumpridos com qualidade.


Qualidade de Produto: Garantir que nossas entregas sejam robustas e com tecnologia e usabilidades avançadas. Você garantirá que nossos produtos resolvem os gaps de mercado e se mantém sempre atualizados e competitivos. Você testará o que foi feito antes de liberar para o cliente.


Integrações: Liderar a documentação e a facilitação técnica para parceiros que vão consumir nossa infraestrutura (Bancos, Plataformas, Fintechs, etc)


O que buscamos (Requisitos):


Background Técnico: Você não precisa codar hoje, mas precisa saber ler uma documentação de API, entender o que é um Webhook, um JSON e discutir arquitetura básica com os devs. (Ex-devs com perfil de liderança são muito bem-vindos).


Experiência/Conhecimento em Fintech/Meios de Pagamento: Entender o fluxo de uma transação financeira é essencial. Conhecimento em novas tecnologias de pagamento, cripto, stablecoins, etc.


Inglês Avançado: Não é obrigatório, mas é um plus! É interessante ser capaz de ler documentações internacionais e eventualmente falar com parceiros globais.


Organização Extrema: Você é quem coloca ordem no caos. Jira/Trello etc são seus melhores amigos. é muito importante ser um profissional organizado.


Bom relacionamento e liderança: Um dos seus papéis essenciais será manter bom relacionamento e comunicação com a equipe comercial e diretoria para definir priorização de tarefas.


Detalhes:

  • Trabalho 100% Remoto
  • Remuneração Competitiva (PJ)

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains with No prior AI experience required . This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content

  • No prior AI experience is required
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: QAQC Senior Analyst
description:
Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a fast-growing, New York-based, MEP engineering firm that has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space in NY.


We’re hiring a Brazil-based, remote professional to own and scale our QAQC design process so every project consistently meets our standards as we grow.


Important


This role is not about line-by-line reviewing design deliverables. Instead, you will ensure the design process is executed correctly and that all quality-check steps are completed on 100% of projects, minimizing design errors, communication breakdowns, and rework.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time (remote)
  • Competitive total compensation


What you’ll do


  • Own the QAQC process end-to-end across MEP projects: define, implement, and continuously improve checklists, stage gates, and “definition of done” criteria.
  • Guarantee compliance: ensure all required quality checks are completed (with traceability) on every project—no exceptions.
  • Standardize workflows: templates, file organization, naming conventions, coordination routines, handoff requirements, and internal documentation.
  • Improve communication and handoffs: reduce information loss between teams, disciplines, and stakeholders.
  • Track quality metrics: build dashboards and weekly reporting around nonconformities, rework drivers, cycle time, recurring errors, and process adherence.
  • Root-cause and prevention: investigate failures, implement corrective actions, and ensure improvements stick.


Requirements

  • Advanced English (written + spoken) to work with a US-based team and clients.
  • Experience in AEC/MEP environments (MEP design, engineering, BIM coordination, project delivery, design ops, PMO, QA/QC)
  • Strong process ownership mindset: disciplined, organized, and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to drive compliance across teams (without being the “reviewer of everything”).
  • Comfortable creating SOPs, checklists, and governance routines that scale.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with tools like Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, ACC/BIM 360, Asana/Monday/Jira, etc.
  • Track record of improving quality and reducing rework through better systems.


Selection Process

  • Application: apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with you CV, English experience and CRM background
  • Screening: English and communication assessment
  • Sales case: short technical challenge
  • Interviews: with leadership and our CEO
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Strategic role in a fast-growing NYC company
  • Our clients love us
  • Strong engineering team in all trades
  • Startup mentality towards growth and team building
  • We only hire people who excel

title: GESTOR(A) DE RECURSOS HUMANOS (RH)
description:

Sobre a vaga


O(a) Gestor(a) de RH será responsável por estruturar e gerenciar os processos de recrutamento, desenvolvimento, desempenho e cultura , garantindo que o time esteja alinhado aos objetivos da empresa, com clareza de papéis, processos bem definidos e alta performance.

Essa pessoa atuará de forma próxima à liderança, com visão estratégica, mas também com capacidade de execução.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Estruturar e gerenciar os processos de Recursos Humanos da empresa;
  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção , alinhados à cultura e às necessidades do negócio;
  • Criar e acompanhar processos de onboarding e offboarding ;
  • Desenvolver e manter descrições de cargos, responsabilidades e expectativas de desempenho ;
  • Implementar e acompanhar avaliações de desempenho , feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI);

  • Estruturar rotinas de acompanhamento, alinhamentos e rituais internos;
  • Garantir comunicação clara entre liderança e time;
  • Apoiar a organização de cargos, níveis, crescimento e planos de carreira;
  • Atuar como guardião da cultura, valores e boas práticas da empresa.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência prévia em Recursos Humanos (generalista ou estratégico);
  • Vivência em recrutamento e seleção , desenvolvimento e gestão de pessoas;
  • Capacidade analítica e de tomada de decisão;
  • Perfil organizado, estruturado e orientado a processos;
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Visão estratégica com foco em crescimento e performance;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambiente remoto.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em empresas digitais, startups ou agências de marketing;
  • Conhecimento em RH estratégico, People Analytics ou OKRs ;
  • Experiência com estruturação de cultura organizacional;
  • Vivência com times remotos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (ClickUp, Notion, Google Workspace, etc.).


Informações adicionais
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ ;
  • Vaga 100% remota , para qualquer cidade do Brasil;
  • Flexibilidade de horário;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento, incluindo atuação estratégica junto à liderança e expansão da área de RH.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Ascendion

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life


We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience.


Experience a community of change-makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.


What You’ll Do:


  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.


Nice to Haves:


  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.

  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)

Location: Remote

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
VelorHealth is an established and rapidly scaling eCommerce brand operating in the 7–8 figure range. We are looking for a highly skilled Paid Social Video Ad Editor to join our creative performance team.


You will be responsible for editing high-performing ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels. This role requires a strong understanding of direct response video editing , split-testing frameworks, and what drives conversions in DTC paid media.


We are not looking for a basic editor. We are looking for someone who understands how to build attention, maintain narrative tension, and convert cold audiences into buyers through video edits engineered for performance—not aesthetics alone.




Responsibilities


  • Edit short-form, performance-optimized video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels
  • Apply proven performance tactics: strong hooks, fast pacing, dynamic cuts, motion graphics, captions, and retention-driving structure
  • Work with raw UGC, product footage, AI-generated assets, voiceovers, and testimonials
  • Collaborate with creative strategists to interpret scripts, briefings, and messaging frameworks into final ads
  • Use AI video generation tools (Sora 2 or equivalent), plus editing software (Premiere, CapCut, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.)
  • Test multiple creative variations designed for A/B performance testing
  • Continuously optimize edits based on data feedback—CTR, hold rate, thumb-stop ratio, CVR, CPA, etc.
  • Maintain brand consistency across dynamic performance creatives
  • Organize and maintain creative assets for versioning, split testing, and performance tracking




Requirements


  • Proven experience editing direct-response paid social ads (DTC experience strongly preferred)
  • Expertise in modern editing software and workflows
  • Experience leveraging AI creative tools including video, voiceover, motion, and script generation
  • Understanding of attention psychology: hooks, curiosity gaps, pattern interrupts, emotional pacing, and social proof stacking
  • Able to strategically incorporate on-screen text, captions, dynamic transitions, and brand elements to maximize watch time
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced direct-response environment with tight turnaround cycles
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating performance-driven ad editing




Bonus Qualifications


  • Prior experience working with 7–8 figure DTC brands
  • Experience editing UGC ads for Meta/TikTok
  • Familiarity with offer testing frameworks and CRO principles
  • Ability to analyze video performance metrics and iterate based on insights




Why This Role Matters


Every new VelorHealth ad you produce has the potential to reach millions. Your edits directly impact revenue, scale, and our mission to help people move freely, stay pain-free, and regain control of their mobility.


If you want to build high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC brand and leverage cutting-edge creative and AI technology, we’d love to meet you.

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;
  • É responsável pela preparação dos materiais que a Companhia divulga para o Mercado Financeiro e pela conferência das informações que são divulgadas para a imprensa;
  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;
  • Preparação e envio de informações para advogados, bancos e órgãos regulamentadores em caso de ofertas públicas de ações ou dívida e controle e monitoramento da base acionária da Companhia;
  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;
  • Preparação dos documentos que precisam ser enviados aos bancos, advogados e órgãos regulamentadores;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: Cloud Security Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
Cloud Security Engineer (Mid-Level)

Location: Remote in Brazil (must)

Duration: 12+ Months

Seniority: Mid-Level (4–6 years’ experience)


Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer with hands-on experience supporting cloud security tools and day-to-day security operations across GCP and AWS environments. This role will support our customers’ Cloud and Security teams by assisting with security monitoring, configuration, posture management, and compliance-related activities.

This is a supporting engineering role . The focus is on maintaining and optimizing existing security tools and controls, not owning architecture design or leading net-new initiatives.


Core Responsibilities (Support-Focused)

  • Supporting implementation and day-to-day management of cloud security controls in GCP using Security Command Center (SCC)
  • Assisting with configuration, monitoring, and tuning of Wiz for cloud posture management and risk detection
  • Supporting Palo Alto security tools, including cloud firewalls and Cortex XDR, with an emphasis on monitoring and alert response
  • Assisting with AWS security support, including IAM configuration, logging, GuardDuty findings, and general security hygiene
  • Supporting cloud security monitoring and incident response workflows in coordination with SOC and SecOps teams
  • Helping validate security controls and configurations tied to HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC2 requirements
  • Assisting with policy enforcement, configuration reviews, and remediation activities based on established governance standards
  • Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer for cloud and security teams
  • (Bonus) Assisting with M365/O365 security configuration, identity controls, or conditional access policies


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or security engineering roles
  • Hands-on experience supporting GCP Security Command Center (SCC)
  • Experience using Wiz for CSPM , risk identification, or posture management
  • Exposure to Palo Alto security tools such as Prisma, Cortex XDR, or cloud firewalls
  • Working knowledge of AWS security fundamentals (IAM, GuardDuty, logging, monitoring)
  • Understanding of identity, access management, and cloud governance concepts
  • Experience supporting compliance or regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, or similar)
  • Familiarity with security monitoring, alert triage, and remediation workflows


Nice to Have

  • Experience with M365 security features such as conditional access or identity protection
  • Exposure to container or workload security in cloud environments Basic experience with infrastructure-as-code or scripting (Terraform, Python, or PowerShell )

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Profitable , +100M ARRR, + 1M MAUs, +8M clients, fintech accelerated in Silicon Valley needs you!

Help us improve the lives of 34 million workers in financial distress

We are a profitable, series A startup growing 10% MoM with more than $60M of annualized revenue helping workers without access to credit. We believe we can improve the lives of Brazilian workers offering salary advances.

We are invested by Monashees, ONEVC, and YCombinator. We believe a top-performing team is the most vital factor to a startup’s success.

Position: Chief of Staff

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO’s strategic partner—helping drive priorities, bring clarity and alignment across teams, and maximize effectiveness.

This is a career accelerator role: you’ll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, with direct exposure to company decision-making, fundraising, growth, and operations. You’ll be embedded in the hardest challenges of scaling a high-growth fintech in one of the world’s most dynamic markets.

Your work will focus on three areas:

1. Strategic Execution & Decision Support

  • Partner with the CEO to prioritize and drive the most critical company-wide initiatives.
  • Dig into strategic questions—pricing, incentives, product-market fit, operational efficiency.
  • Generate high-leverage insights from data, market research, and direct user feedback.
  • Prepare decision frameworks, board materials, and briefing docs to enable fast, high-quality decisions.

2. Cross-Functional Alignment & Special Projects

  • Act as a connector across Product, Marketing, Finance, Credit and Operations—ensuring priorities are clear and execution sharp.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks, whether data gaps, misalignment, or process bottlenecks.
  • Drive high-impact special projects—ranging from new product launches to operational improvements.

  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review)

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência na área de QA/Testes
  • Conhecimento básico em testes de software
  • Noções de automação de testes
  • Familiaridade com: Testes funcionais e não funcionais e Casos de teste e cenários
  • Conhecimento básico de: APIs REST, HTTP (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
  • Noções de Git
  • Conhecimento básico em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência ou estudos com ferramentas de automação, como: Playwright, Cypress e/ou Selenium
  • Conhecimento em testes de API (Postman, Insomnia)
  • Noções de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento básico em JavaScript ou outra linguagem de programação
  • Noções de BDD (Gherkin / Given-When-Then)


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.
